text:
Priya (eng-ml): Follow-up from yesterday's postmortem about recurring eviction/throughput regressions. We need owners for concrete eval additions (regression tests, promptset, load profiles, chaos drill). Can we assign now?
Ethan (eng-sre): I'll take the chaos drill and the triage checklist update. Plan to run a controlled eviction drill in staging Tue 11am. Need test payloads and a small script to simulate partial KV loss.
Sam (eng-ml): I'll handle regression suite updates: add burst-write + warm/cold cache permutations, and a short promptset for long-context rewinds. ETA: Thursday noon.
Dana (eng-platform): Infra owner here. I'll provision a 4xA100 ephemeral staging cluster and wire up the nightly job for the new regression matrix. Will also add a CI smoke test for PRs.
Priya (eng-ml): Great. Priya to own evaluation tracking sheet: I'll add columns for owner, due date, PR link, infra ticket, and pass criteria. Pass = 48h of nightly runs with no new eviction regressions and p95 within 10% of baseline.
Sam (eng-ml): Example test command I'll include in the PR: `pytest tests/eviction/test_replay.py::test_burst_then_read --env=staging`
Ethan (eng-sre): For the chaos drill I need a small artifact: `scripts/partial_kv_lose --percentage=30 --duration=120` so the drill runner can trigger it safely. Also add abort criteria (error rate > 1% sustained or infra quota exceeded).
Dana (eng-platform): Will create job `nightly/eviction-regression` and short-lived cluster ticket STG-4821. Posting creds and job URL in the tracker.
Priya (eng-ml): Also add an int8 matrix axis and a note to run quantized and fp16 kernels; last incident showed int8 fallback differences. Sam, include `--kernel=int8|fp16` in tests.
Sam (eng-ml): Noted. I'll include kernel flags + a small README explaining expected behavior and how to interpret fallback logs.
PagerBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/eviction-patterns — 4 action items assigned.
Ethan (eng-sre): I'll add a small observability alert: `metric:kv_eviction_rate` with a p95 latency correlate rule. Add to runbook under "signals to watch".
Priya (eng-ml): Wrap-up: owners + due dates updated in tracker: Sam (regression/tests) Thu, Ethan (chaos/drill) Tue, Dana (infra/jobs) Wed. We'll do a short sync in Monday standup to confirm PRs are green.
Sam (eng-ml): Uploaded PR draft and promptset link in tracker. Will request reviews from Priya + Ethan.
Dana (eng-platform): Cluster provisioned, ticket STG-4821 created, job URL: https://ci/redwood/nightly/eviction-regression
Ethan (eng-sre): Scheduled drill Tue 11am, tagging on-call. Will coordinate abort and rollback steps.
Priya (eng-ml): Thanks team. Once PRs merge and nightly runs are stable for 48h we'll close these action items.
